Flowrite Group is a prominent leader and trusted name in the earthworks, demolition, and civil industry. Our unwavering commitment to delivering top-notch quality work sets us apart. We believe that every project, no matter the scale, deserves the utmost attention to detail and excellence. This dedication to excellence, combined with our modern fleet of machinery, allows us to consistently exceed our clients’ expectations.

At Flowrite Group, we recognise that our success is a result of the exceptional team we have cultivated. We place great emphasis on fostering a positive work environment that promotes collaboration, innovation, and growth.

We are seeking highly skilled Auto Electrician to join our team of passionate professionals who share a common drive to make a difference in the industry.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Perform electrical, and air conditioning repairs and maintenance in accordance with relevant technical specifications and standards
Read and interpret wiring diagrams and technical specifications accurately
Accurately use test equipment to locate electrical and electronic malfunctions
Install electrical equipment and electronic components in motor vehicles
Perform works safely and in an environmentally responsible manner
Diagnose electrical and air conditioning faults accurately and efficient manner
Conduct electrical and air conditioning repairs and maintenance in accordance with manufacturer and technical specifications
Complete documentation accurately, including job cards, service sheets, parts records, timesheets, or other information as required
Install electrical & air conditioning equipment as per manufacturer and technical specifications
Fault find, and diagnose electrical and air conditioning problems accurately and thoroughly
Use and maintain diagnostic equipment correctly and in accordance with manufacturer specifications

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Relevant Trade Qualifications
Demonstrated solid diagnostic and fault-finding skills
Safety focused
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Good communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you possess the qualities and skills required for this role and you feel this job is for you, please apply now!
Salary: Between $75,000 and $80,000 per annum + Super

Intura has a full range of capabilities and services for the energy and resource sectors. These services cover the full asset lifecycle from construction, start-up to decommissioning.

At Intura, our leadership team has over 150 years of combined experience across a broad technical and industry base. With a strong focus on developing our team’s capabilities, we’re committed to delivering lasting value to our clients. This approach has resulted significant growth and doubling of our client base in the last year.

Intura is seeking qualified and experienced Calibration Technician to join our team of professionals in Chinchilla QLD

Job duties include but will not be limited to:
Performing routine equipment maintenance

Troubleshooting equipment failures
Conducting equipment repairs
Responding to client queries
Suggesting equipment upgrades
Maintaining calibration equipment and supplies
Completing job cards and equipment reports

Technical Expertise: Knowledge of industry calibration standards and proficiency with measuring equipment and specialised software
Hands-On Skills: Strong practical skills for working with intricate machinery and performing adjustments
Attention to Detail: A meticulous approach to conducting tests, recording data, and ensuring accuracy
Problem-Solving: The ability to quickly identify and resolve issues with instruments and equipment
Analytical Skills: Capability to analyse readings, assess equipment performance, and suggest improvements
